operations.title: Power-Mackey compatibility is the unit sieve of a square-free resonance modulus
operations.statement: For q:G->H, with R_q=rad(exp ker(q)*exp A_q), compatible indices are exactly gcd(n,R_q)=1; they form the unit residues modulo R_q, are multiplicatively closed, periodic, and have density phi(R_q)/R_q.
operations.scope: Finite algebraic correspondence indicator only; no Euler product, Carrier primes, geometric Frobenius, or physical selection.

operations.title: Radical resonance periodicity and multiplicativity test
operations.protocol: Check periodicity through 120, multiplicativity for 30x30 pairs, and exact period density for radical moduli 2,3,6,10,30.
operations.falsifier: Any compatibility indicator fails to factor through units modulo the radical.

operations.title: Radical resonance unit sieve research packet

operations.outcome: pass: five radical families satisfy periodicity, multiplicativity, and phi(R)/R density across 5049 exact checks

evidence.paraphrase: Exact congruence checks verify the unit-sieve corollary.
